brand_mentions.result: Grasscrafts is a Kolkata-based brand that produces handmade, eco-friendly home decor, furniture, and corporate gift packaging using natural fibers like Sitalpati, Kauna grass, Madurkathi, Sabai grass, bamboo, and cane [1][2][3]. Founded by Sristi Dey, the company works directly with artisans to create sustainable, biodegradable products as alternatives to synthetic, mass-produced items [4][3]. You can purchase their goods online or contact them for custom and bulk orders via their website at www.grasscrafts.com or by calling +91 6290744782 [1][5][3].

Grasscrafts by Abalone is a Kolkata-based retailer and manufacturer that produces handmade, eco-friendly gifts, home décor, and furniture using natural fibers like cane and sabai grass [1][2]. The business emphasizes sustainable, artisanal craftsmanship and supports local makers by offering retail, bulk, and custom order services [1]. Products are available through their website, and customers can contact them for orders or inquiries at +916290744782 [1][2].

Grasscrafts is an Indian brand founded in 2015 that specializes in sustainable, handwoven home decor and lifestyle products made from natural fibers like Sitalpati, kauna, and water hyacinth [1][2]. The company partners directly with traditional weaving communities to produce items such as storage baskets, bags, and mats [2][3]. Customer reviews are generally positive, highlighting the products' aesthetic appeal, quality, and sustainable nature, though some customers have noted occasional long delivery times [4].
